title: Will Arch Manning, Dante Moore and other QB prospect questions influence NFL trade deadline?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Will Arch Manning, Dante Moore and other QB prospect questions influence NFL trade deadline?
sources.description: In April, teams were wary of trading away 2027 picks due to the buzz around the class, specifically quarterbacks. If the hype has dimmed, are those picks more for sale?
